# Requirements Quality Checklist: Landing Page Conversion

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurable quality of the landing-page requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [../spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the intended number or selection rule for featured products and visible category links defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Are destinations and behavior specified for every navigation, profile, support, social, and payment link? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, §FR-010, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Are loading, empty, and failure requirements specified for catalog search, featured products, category data, cart updates, newsletter signup, and purchase history? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the content and privacy boundaries of the last-purchase summary fully specified, including which order/product fields may be shown? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Are “high-quality” hero imagery and “prominent” CTA defined by objective content or presentation criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are predictive-search matching rules, suggestion count, minimum query length, and selection destinations unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Are newsletter signup success, duplicate subscription, incentive eligibility, and retry outcomes explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “immediately” for cart badge updates reconciled with the one-second measurable threshold? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the original request for customer ratings/reviews and the clarified MVP exclusion reconciled consistently across inputs, stories, and requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Input, §Clarifications, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the profile control's authentication-invariant appearance consistent with the conditional last-purchase content behavior? [Consistency, Spec §Story 5, §FR-003, §FR-013–015]
- [ ] CHK011 Are category, New Arrivals, Deals, featured-product, and search destinations consistent with the product-list feature's navigation model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §FR-008]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Are latency metrics for page visibility, search suggestions, and cart badge updates defined with reproducible conditions and measurement boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Can the 90% usability targets and subjective clarity/trust rating threshold be measured with a defined participant/sample method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-004, §SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are signed-out, authenticated-without-history, authenticated-with-history, and unavailable-last-purchase scenarios complete and mutually exclusive? [Coverage, Spec §Story 5, §FR-013–015]
- [ ] CHK015 Are recovery requirements defined for search service errors, newsletter delivery/persistence failure, and cart mutation failure without misleading success feedback? [Coverage, Exception/Recovery, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the spec define fallback content and accessible alternatives when hero, category, featured-product, or last-purchase imagery is missing? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006, §FR-013]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are responsive breakpoints or acceptance viewport ranges and sticky-header behavior specified sufficiently to prevent content obstruction? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK018 Are accessibility requirements explicit for predictive suggestions, cart feedback, newsletter status, and dynamic purchase-history content? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Ambiguities

- [ ] CHK019 Are ownership, availability expectations, and failure behavior documented for Catalog, Cart, Identity, Order, Newsletter, and store-content dependencies? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are assumptions about the 10% offer, benefit claims, product merchandising, and support/social/payment destinations validated by an identified store owner? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
